label: Parcel ID
why it matters: Pull any record on the parcel: NYC BBL, NY SWIS + print key, Florida folio.

label: Market
why it matters: NYC, Long Island or Florida.

label: Property address
why it matters: What you're calling about.

label: Owner on record
why it matters: The name on the tax roll, exactly as recorded.

label: Owner first name
why it matters: Greet them by name.

label: Owner last name
why it matters: Greet them by name.

label: Owner type
why it matters: Individual, Company, Trust, Estate or Government: who decides.

label: Person behind the LLC
why it matters: The human to ask for when a company owns it.

label: Their role
why it matters: Head officer, managing agent, owner…

label: Owner mailing address
why it matters: Where the owner actually is.

label: Owner lives there
why it matters: Talk home and family, not investment.

label: Absentee owner
why it matters: Not watching the property day to day.

label: Owner out of state
why it matters: Managing from far away.

label: Months owned
why it matters: How long since they bought (from the last recorded sale).

label: Same owner since 2021
why it matters: Long hold: equity and a life change are likely.

label: Held by an estate
why it matters: The family decides what happens next.

label: On NYC's lien sale list
why it matters: Behind on city charges: a real reason to talk.

label: Lien list date
why it matters: Which list it was on.

label: Pre-foreclosure
why it matters: Lis pendens or default on file.

label: Loan matures within 12 months
why it matters: A refinance or sale decision is coming.
New York source: RealEstateAPI / Propwire; ACRIS estimate in app

label: Loan maturity date
why it matters: When the loan comes due.

label: Free and clear
why it matters: No open mortgage: full equity.

label: Estimated equity
why it matters: What they'd walk away with.

label: Property type
why it matters: SFR, MFR, CONDO, MOBILE, LAND.

label: Units
why it matters: Rent roll and how many tenants.

label: Year built
why it matters: Age, condition and renovation talk.

label: Building sq ft
why it matters: Size of what's standing.

label: Lot sq ft
why it matters: Land, room to expand.

label: Zoning
why it matters: What can be built.

label: Room to build (sq ft)
why it matters: Zoning allows more than what stands: development value.

label: Market value
why it matters: The county's market value (Florida just value, NY full market value).

label: Assessed value (NYC)
why it matters: NYC publishes assessed, not market, value.

label: Last sale date
why it matters: When it last changed hands.

label: Last sale price
why it matters: What they paid.

label: Properties they own
why it matters: One home or a portfolio (same name + mailing address).

label: Portfolio value
why it matters: How big a player they are.

label: Talking points
why it matters: One factual line to read before the call, built from the columns above.
example: Owner: Segundo R Naula; 2-unit multifamily, built 1920, 2,390 sq ft; assessed $53,400 (NYC); zoning allows about 3,736 more sq ft.
